_doc: Equivalence-prover allowlist. Every entry acknowledges an INTENDED divergence between the current tree and validation/baselines/v68. Entries require file (repo-relative), reason, and wave (e.g. v6.9). The prover fails on any un-allowlisted diff and on any stale entry whose file no longer diverges.

entries.reason: v6.8.1 microcopy fixes: (1) the micro ships-from row now YIELDS when the dedicated az_ships_from line is effective (azShipsAllowed() gate) so the buy box never says Ships-from twice; (2) label resolution unchanged otherwise. Companion CSS guard .cx-az-micro__row[hidden]{display:none!important} fixes the display:flex-defeats-[hidden] bare-truck-icon bug (CSS is outside baseline scope).

v6.10 merchant-selectable ships-from display format: azShipsFormat() decodes the lean 's'/'p' code from the gated ships member (draft override preview.sf only inside a VERIFIED preview session, fail-closed to subtle); azBuildStock gains a shipsName param and a prominent branch (.cx-az-stock__ships--prominent: truck icon + @@COUNTRY@@ sentinel split into prefix/country/suffix, textContent-only, sentinel-less fallback to the plain composed line); azMountStock hoists the warehouse name. Subtle path markup byte-identical to v6.8. Pinned by sims/az-split.cjs F1-F5 + mutants m6/m7.

v6.11 survey methodology full-text editability: surveyBuildPanel's merchant branch substitutes the built-in text's live-number tokens ({{ total }}/{{ yes }}/{{ percent }}, flexible inner whitespace) with the cfg.survey numbers before the textContent write, so a merchant-edited copy of the built-in explanation keeps tracking the survey numbers. Fail-safe 0 on non-finite numbers; sink stays textContent-only. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs M1-M7 + mutants m1-m4 and harness section-5 v6.11 pins.

v7 per-product proof wave: survey gates + island rewritten per-product (cellexia.product_survey metaobject read, content-presence gate, per-product outcome rows + methodology/verifier fallbacks, legacy sampleSize/yesCount/format reads and the draft surveyFormat preview member removed); study island gains sub/pn/pw/pl/pi members (m1/m2 composition retired) + str.sub/str.fn; bottle title now interpolates the pluralized days label and body/point_1..3 gain theme-block overrides (+4 schema settings). Pinned by harness section-5 v7 block + sims/survey-methodology.cjs.

v7 per-product proof wave: five-format survey machinery (SURVEY_FORMATS, surveyBuildFormat, buildSurveyDots, cfg.preview.surveyFormat) replaced by one zero-arg outcomes-forward surveyBuildSection (derived row percents, decorative bar fills, @@YES@@/@@TOTAL@@ sentinel labels, fail-closed row/total/rec validation); surveyBuildPanel keeps v6.11 token substitution with per-product numbers (total=sample size, yes=rec); study builder gains the always-on subject line + protocol fact chips and drops m1/m2 paragraphs. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs (59 checks, 7 mutants) + harness v7 block.

v6.10 ships-from format plumbing: the gated ships member gains the lean live format code ("f": cfg.amazon.shipsFromFormat | slice: 0, the v6.5 place-code convention) and the armed preview member gains the lean draft code ("sf": cx_prev.draftConfig.shipsFromFormat | slice: 0, tokenless closed enum). No gate or emission-structure changes.

v8 proof library + compact modes: the #cx-ba-config island emission is DELETED (the PDP before/after widget retires — the standalone results-gallery block replaces it; the show_ba/cx_bas reads are kept because they still feed the outer emission gate and cx_draft_any), and the survey/study/bottle islands gain lean LIVE compact members ('"cm": 1' under cfg.dermSurvey.compact / cfg.clinicalStudy.compact / cfg.emptyBottleGuarantee.compact == true strict gates) plus the compact-gated surveyStrings.more_outcomes key. Pinned by harness section-5 v8 block + sims/survey-methodology.cjs C-series.

v8 compact modes + BA retirement: surveyBuildSection grows the compact branch (top-line first-valid-row inline, '+ N more outcomes' disclosure over the surveyBuildOutcomes list, bindSurveyMore toggle, stale-island degrade ships the list visible), studyBuildSection gains the cx-study--compact modifier (same DOM), bottleBuildNode the slim-band branch (points stay in the untouched modal); the ba* builders + PROOF_ORDER ba row + dispatch branch are deleted (the verified_before_after EVIDENCE marker moves to cellexia-proof.js); boot()'s verified branch sets window.CellexiaBooster.__preview = true for the proof asset's beacon/draft contract. Pinned by sims/survey-methodology.cjs (C-series + mutants m11/m12) + harness v8 block.

v8 NEW shared asset: ES5 IIFE with pf-prefixed helper twins (zero name overlap with the pdp sim extraction surface), proofFetch (8s timeout, one retry, cb(null) fail-closed), the press band / endorsement wall / results gallery renderers + filter drawer + lightbox, ZERO innerHTML anywhere (SVG via createElementNS, entity decode via a bounded replace chain), every URL through the pfHttps gate, beacons suppressed via window.CellexiaBooster.__preview OR sessionStorage cx_preview_token. Carries the moved verified_before_after EVIDENCE marker plus the press/derm_endorsements markers. Pinned by harness (EVIDENCE, class coverage, zero-innerHTML escape discipline) + sims/proof-gallery.cjs (29-function extraction, 6 mutants).

v8.2 ultra-compact branches (cm-guarded, textContent-only, same DOM): pressBuildSection collapses to one row (quote starts [hidden]; bindLogo tap reveals + rotates, a second tap on the ACTIVE logo re-hides + clears aria-pressed); endoBuildSection composes ONE

head row (count · shown_of, per-part degrade, re-composed by setProgress after Show more appends into the same wall); resultsBuildSection emits only the cx-results--compact root modifier (CSS leverage). cm-absent paths byte-identical to v8. Pinned by sims/proof-gallery.cjs U/V series + mutants m7/m8/m9 and the harness class-coverage self-test (--compact trio).

v8.3 COMPACT middle tier: each of the three builders resolves density ONCE (var ultra = conf.cm === 2; var compact = conf.cm === 1; strict === so strings/unknown codes fall back to full) and the v8.2 branches are repointed to cm 2 under RENAMED --ultra root modifiers (cx-press--ultra / cx-endo--ultra / cx-results--ultra); cm 1 now means the NEW compact tier (cx-press--compact: quote ALWAYS visible, rotation like full; cx-endo--compact: composed H2 head line with inline shown_of; cx-results--compact: root-modifier-only CSS leverage). Pinned by sims/proof-gallery.cjs U/C series + mutants m7/m8/m10 and the harness class-coverage self-test (--compact + --ultra trios).

v8.7 NEW embed replacing the three v8 SECTION blocks (press/derm-endorsements/results-gallery .liquid, entries retired this wave): the store's legacy Liquid templates cannot take section app blocks (merchant-verified), so the three proof widgets merge into ONE app embed (target body, name 'Cellexia proof library', 22 chars). The #cx-press-config/#cx-endo-config/#cx-results-config islands keep their v8/v8.3 payload byte-for-byte (incl. the two-code cm density members) — only the gate assigns are renamed per widget (cx_p_*/cx_e_*/cx_r_*) and the data-cx-mount divs are gone: cellexia-proof.js now self-inserts via the ordered .cx-proof-band (after .pdp__tabs on product pages, end of #main elsewhere, fail-closed). Pinned by harness section-5 v8.7 block + the CM_ISLANDS density pins.

v8.13 product display names: new `assign cx_pname = product.metafields.cellexia.display_name.value | default: product.title` and the three name interpolations (survey rec_line, survey outcomes_intro, study sub) switch from product.title to cx_pname. The metafield is translatable (native Shopify translations registered by the Product names admin page), so localized pages serve the merchant's exact per-language name; unset falls back to the title — byte-identical output for shops that never set a display name.
